content.title: Convert JPG to PNG Instantly
content.p1: JPG is the world's most popular image format, but it often lacks the versatility needed for modern web design. By converting to PNG, you gain access to lossless compression and transparency support.
content.p2: Our JPG to PNG Converter is designed for speed and privacy, handling everything directly in your browser without uploading your sensitive photos to any server.

lossless.title: Lossless Quality
lossless.desc: Stop image degradation. PNG uses lossless compression to keep every pixel perfect during edits.

private.title: 100% Private
private.desc: Files are processed locally on your device. We never see, store, or upload your images.

transparency.title: Transparency Ready
transparency.desc: Convert to the preferred format for logos, icons, and graphics that require transparent backgrounds.

faq.title: Raster Format Insights
faq.a1: Converting to PNG stops future quality loss. It's best for images you plan to edit further or need to keep sharp.
faq.a2: Since we process files in your browser, the limit is determined by your device's memory, usually allowing files up to 50MB easily.
